title: RL Circuits & LC Oscillations
theory: An inductor opposes current *change*: $\mathcal{E}_L = -L\dfrac{dI}{dt}$; at $t = 0$ it is an **open switch**, as $t\to\infty$ a **plain wire** — the mirror image of the capacitor rules; $\tau = L/R$. LC circuit: charge sloshes with $T = 2\pi\sqrt{LC}$, energy trading $\dfrac{q^2}{2C} \leftrightarrow \dfrac{1}{2}LI^2$.
